title: Black Bob Thunderbird figurine
subtitle: Chibi figurine of the costume mascot · 80 mm tall on a display base · red, white, black · millimetres

meshes.label: White (beak, face, lightning bolt, zigzags, legs, feet, BB)

scale_note: 80 mm tall is a first guess for a 'little' figurine. Type a different height in the real-size box to preview it; HEIGHT_MM in build.py sets it.
notes_title: v6: borrowing from the school logo
notes: v6 takes cues from the Black Bob logo (the keychain's source): (1) a white lightning bolt down the chest instead of the starburst, the 'thunder' in Thunderbird; (2) the logo's beak: long, flat-topped, ending in a hook, with a long open grin whose corners meet under the eye. The upper beak is deeper and narrower than v5's, and the lower jaw is long and slim with the tip turned up a little; (3) a slightly smaller head, so the beak dominates as in the logo; (4) a black cap bill, tipped up a little (the keychain's black bill); (5) three red crest feathers sticking out the back of the head under the cap. The body, wings and feet are as in v5. Check: does it feel like our logo bird now? Is the beak length OK? It is the main thing that needs supports.
